'''Sunken Sarlacc cantina''' was a public [[Cantina/Legends|drinking and dining establishment]] in the city of [[Sobrik]], [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The Sunken Sarlacc cantina was a large building located in the [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorrian]] city of [[Sobrik]], occupied by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

Even after the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] took over the town, some of its citizens still spent their time in the cantina during the occupation. However while the patrons were enjoying their drinks, the streets were patrolled by [[Imperial soldier]]s and [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and several [[Security camera/Legends|security cameras]] were installed around the building.

Despite all the precautions taken by the Empire to keep the local citizens at bay, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sent their agents in order to weaken the positions of the Sith at Sobrik. At one stage the Republic forces entered the cantina and activated the Republic hymn to inspire the remaining dwellers and freedom fighters to start a riot against the invaders.

==Layout==
The cantina consisted of several corridors and medium rooms, as well as a large hall, where people gathered to have drinks and relax. Several [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] dancers entertained the patrons.

The interior design of the bar was based upon the Imperial style, which may have been due to Imperial renovations made in the city.

==Behind the scenes==
The cantina is one of the locations to be visited by the players of the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the quest given by the Republic characters. Activating the speaker with the "Republic March," originally from the previous video game by [[BioWare]], ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', is part of a larger mission to infiltrate the city of Sobrik.
